headline: Front-Line Ownership Activity Shifts Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Callahan’s Passage has widened its lead as the busiest ownership front, rising to 68 events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour window; casualties are accelerating on both sides, though enlistment rates have cooled. Stlican Shelf has reached 60 events, with Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost still the principal trouble spots, while fighting and enlistments continue to quicken. Fisherman’s Row has climbed to 58 events and remains divided, with six Colonial bases and two neutral positions; six actions were logged in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse has eased from its earlier pace to 27 daily events, but casualty rates are again accelerating and ownership remains mixed at eight Colonial, one Warden. Mooring County shows a modest rise to 12 events, including three recently, with The Wind Hills still central. Nevish Line has become a fresh near-term watch, recording nine events in two hours amid heavy fighting and a split six-Warden, two-Colonial ledger. Other sectors are largely quiet or show combat without recent ownership action.
